关键词: Results of Operations and Financial Condition
主要内容: Nicholas Financial, Inc. (NASDAQ: NICK) reported its financial results for the three months ended December 31, 2013. The company announced that net earnings decreased by 17% to $3,827,000 compared to $4,596,000 for the same period in 2012. Diluted net earnings per share also declined by 18% to $0.31, down from $0.38 in the prior-year period. Revenue increased by 1% to $20,761,000, compared to $20,605,000 in the three months ended December 31, 2012. The report was filed as part of Form 8-K with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on February 4, 2014.
